How to prepare for winter weather in St Petersburg?
The weather is very cold in Petersburg,: The weather in St Petersburg is very cold, particularly because the city is close to the sea, so it is considered colder than Moscow in winter. Snow falls on the city and the lakes and rivers freeze over, creating scenes straight out of a fairy tale. Make sure you pack clothes suited to the city’s cold weather, such as thermal and waterproof layers. Don’t forget gloves and warm woollen hats.
